parsed.explanation: Parent imposes active traveler-facing exposures: visa/passport gender-marker screening, possible refusal, permanent ineligibility for suspected misrepresentation, detentions/stranding, federal custody abuse, hostile counterterrorism language, and some state facility bans. These are severe if outed and not fully remedied. The division has unusually strong visitor-facing protections: public accommodation anti-discrimination, facilities access, hate-crime enforcement, courts compelling care, refuge/safe-passage measures, reducing in-state risk; custody remains consent-decree not baseline, local sports/ballot friction. Integrated: elevated risk, better than parent due state shield but border/federal layer prevents higher reduced-risk score.
